text:
Ava: quick UX review: proposing a small token pill at top-right, a single action button that morphs between "Stop generation" (while streaming) and "Re-run" (after). prompt library moves to a collapsible right rail, bottom sheet on mobile. mock: https://figma.redwood/playground/stream-compact
Diego: single morph button 👍 fewer clicks. concern: discoverability for token count. suggest tiny inline +delta next to each assistant message that fades after 4s.
Priya: accessibility: streaming partials should use aria-live="polite" and we must avoid spamming screen readers. token pill needs aria-label like "Message tokens: 12". also verify color contrast in dark mode.
Sam: backend: client-side estimate on stream then reconcile with server final. stop should send cancel and server returns partial with tokens. UI: show divider "Stopped (partial output)" with final token delta.
Ava: copy tweak: prefer "Re-run" vs "Regenerate". keyboard shortcuts: Esc=Stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter=Run. will update figma and post interaction video.
CI-Bot: artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/stream-compact-v1.png
